convention: the fields are conj(optilux(conj(x))): Optilux writes the NLSE with the opposite sign of the imaginary unit
equation: the Manakov equation of the unique-field mode (ismanakov true, 8/9 gamma), no PMD and no birefringence (pmdpar 0: one waveplate, the identity)

link.amplification: ideal (noiseless, alpha L at the end of every span)

name: optilux_manakov
script: tools/record_optilux.m (fiber with steptype symm, dzmax 1000 m, dphi1fwm false, stepupd nlp, dphimax 1e9; ampliflat with the gain alpha L)
signal: 3 channels of 16-QAM at 32 GBd spaced by 50 GHz (comnum.wdm_grid), RRC roll-off 0.1, 8 samples per symbol, 2.0 dBm per channel split between two polarisations, 512 symbols, seed 1 (comnum: the symbols of every channel and polarisation drawn in order from one generator)
